policy_source: README AD-13/AD-14/AD-15 and app/policy.py at main 2252284 (banking-policy #7 and fraud-integration #8 merged), README scenario table.

fields.extraction: what the FIRST message states (currency null unless the customer names it; 'pesos'/'$' alone is not a currency); a list of dates accepts either; a missing key is not scored
fields.expected_reason: the dispute reason the explanation assessment should return; null when the case never reaches the explanation step
fields.acceptable_charges: charges the customer would confirm as theirs (either charge of a claimed duplicate pair)
fields.expected_credit_transactions: credited charge(s) that count as correct; empty when no credit is allowed

S04-es.rationale: The customer's own account says they may have taken a taxi both days: the explanation contradicts a double charge (inconsistent) or stays unclear after one follow-up -> person (evaluate_explanation). Most judgment-dependent label in the set.
S04-es.adjudication: Codex labeled the reason 'unclear', Claude 'duplicate'. Adjudicated: both accepted. The customer claims a double charge (duplicate) but is unsure it was one ride, which the policy's 'unclear' also covers; the expected outcome (escalated, needs_review, no credit) is the same under either reading.
S04-es.card_block_rationale: reason duplicate or unclear is not a denial: no block

second_labeling.labeler: Codex CLI (codex exec, gpt-5.6-terra), same written rules, did not see labels_v1

changes_from_v1.reason: AD-14 (banking-policy) adds a protective card block on fraud escalations; labeled from policy.protective_action: a claim (denial or card out of hands) plus a fraud signal (fraud score above the threshold, a card-present charge denied, a card out of the customer's hands). null when the case is not expected to escalate.

changes_from_v1.field: final state, escalation reason, credit, dispute reason, extraction: unchanged
changes_from_v1.reason: every labeled charge's screening and evidence verdict was recomputed with the merged policy on the rebuilt fixture and did not change. The fixture now posts SYN-DEMO-TAXI-2 at 2026-06-15 12:04, 4 minutes after TAXI-1 (within DUPLICATE_WINDOW_MINUTES = 10), so S03's double charge is still a verifiable twin; the fraud gate moved from >= 30 to > 30 and no labeled charge scores exactly 30. The scripts were written against the earlier charge list (TAXI-2 on 16 June), so S03, S04 and S24 customers mention 16 June; their extraction labels stay faithful to the message.
